title: Upper Body God
author: Denis H.
desc: The goal for this program is to buildings a huge and aesthetic upper body. The volume is for people who are in a cut. Overall there isn’t really an emphasis on strength it’s just a hypertrophy program.

ex.note: This is included to add some lower back training but also the hamstring
Use neutral grip and some arch on the back to stretch out the lats.
Focus on letting the lat get stretched on the bottom part of the range of motion and keeping your elbows tucked to your body while not letting the traps take over
Focus on retracting the scapula to feel the contraction on your mid traps
Go up to your heavy sets. Then let the weight stay the same and try to do one more rep. You can superset it with the neck curl
Focus on getting fast reps without having any pauses
Do this with a relatively heavy weight and don’t use your shoulders
If your don’t have this option use cables, but regardless you need to do this with one arm emphasising the stretch
Add a little incline and sit on a bench for this one
Do this as a superset with the curls for time saving
Stretch out the traps and retract them. Use wider grip
Perform with underhand grip and focus on constant tension
Sit on a bench and just retract your shoulders
Make the bar hit your upper pec
Hold 1s on the contractions
Feel the stretch and don’t rest on the top of the movement
Let your lower back get pushed
Do AMRAP sets to get the best results
